journey.title: Produce a blog post from a consumer-declared style
journey.purpose: The scenario's first vertical slice and its primary reason to exist. A consuming scenario declares a voice as a file in its own folder; the operator converges an outline, then converges each section against its own candidate set, sees coherence measured across the assembled sections, and commits a document whose every candidate carries provenance.

steps.intent: Confirm the consumer's declared style registered and see which file owns it
Read the resolved style to know what it will actually instruct
Create the document; feasibility is decided before any section is generated
Converge the outline and then each section by pinning and rejecting rather than ranking
Read measured cross-section coherence and assemble the committed sections
